subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should this issue remain a separate Discord `media://inbound` resolver tracker until live proof identifies the root/ID/lifetime mismatch, or should it be folded into the queued-attachment tracker after the related PR lands?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the failure path but does not identify which Discord media lifetime path is actually failing in current main, and an adjacent open PR covers only queued CDN-expiry loss.

options.title: Keep Separate Until Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for a focused Discord DM reproduction that distinguishes saved-file URI misses from queued CDN-expiry loss.

options.title: Fold Into Queued Attachment Work
options.body: Treat the issue as covered by the queued-attachment path only after the related PR lands and live proof shows the same repro no longer fails.

options.title: Queue A Repair Now
options.body: Start a fix attempt immediately, accepting that automation may need to stop if it cannot reproduce the Discord-specific mismatch.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a focused Discord DM reproduction that distinguishes saved-file URI misses from queued CDN-expiry loss.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history signal for the current inbound media reference implementation.
